raw_text: r/geopolitics — Chinese state media just aired footage claiming to show PLA troops conducting 'routine patrols' near Doklam. Anyone else notice the vehicles look identical to 2017 standoff footage? The terrain markings and unit patches are the same ones documented in the original crisis. This smells like a recycled propaganda push. India hasn't responded officially yet but some Indian defense accounts are already amplifying it as a fresh provocation. Classic information warfare playbook.
